title: The same fraction at higher stakes
hook: Two stated cases: explore the stated acceptance rule and the monetary scale.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the stated acceptance rule and the monetary scale affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Expected, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the stated acceptance rule and the monetary scale in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

provenance.sourceEntryOriginal: - **165.** Offers stay near 40–50% even at stakes worth months of wages (Cameron, 1999), but rejections fall as stakes grow very large (Andersen, Ertaç, Gneezy, Hoffman & List, 2011).
